substance.statement: The report compares the backends declared under configuration.day and configuration.tool-night in host/lab-configurations.toml against the sizing parameters and invariants in tools/ops/sizing_map.py.
The report states context_tokens, parallel_slots and max_tokens for omen-dense-27b and omen-perception in both configurations.
The report identifies which backends change between live and absent when the lab moves from day to tool-night.
